name: forge
description: Claude Code plugins for making things and then checking them: design-forge for visual work, story-forge for long-form fiction, deck-forge for presentations, proof-forge for verifying exports, music-forge for songs and music videos, game-forge for making games, explainer-forge for narrated explainer videos. All built on the same idea — judgment stays with the model, and anything expressed as a number gets measured instead of eyeballed.

plugins.name: design-forge
plugins.description: Adversarial builder/critic loop, a measurement harness that computes what a screenshot cannot show (type ladder, worst-case accent count, WCAG contrast, target size), a licence-cleared asset library, a photo-to-3D Blender modelling loop, a scroll-film site builder. Prose editing lives in story-forge.

plugins.name: story-forge
plugins.description: A long-form fiction pipeline: braindump to dossier, outlining, story-hacking, drafting, a three-pass line edit that strips AI prose patterns, a continuity and chronology audit, and a final export that removes invisible provenance characters.

plugins.name: deck-forge
plugins.description: Build decks from shape primitives so they survive a Google Slides import fully editable, then measure them: type legibility from the AVIXA element-height model, WCAG contrast resolved against the real backdrop by z-order, and native-chart detection. The component library never creates a chart, and the audit catches one if you reach around it.

plugins.name: proof-forge
plugins.description: Verify what came out of the render. Compare two exports and mark exactly where they differ — video with timecoded markers and an EDL, stills with a bounding box, audio with a phase-invert null test. The threshold is derived from the pair being compared, so a routine re-encode produces nothing and one bad second produces one marker.

plugins.name: music-forge
plugins.description: Make a song and a video for it, measured instead of eyeballed: write lyrics for AI music generators with scripts that count syllables and rhymes, check what was actually sung, turn a finished song plus a shot plan into a frame-exact music video with OpenRouter video models and ffmpeg (plan validation, cost-capped animation, original-song cut, captions, vertical teasers), and scan tracks for tempo, key and singer consistency.

plugins.name: game-forge
plugins.description: Make a game with Claude Code agents, measured instead of eyeballed: 3D models baked to 2D sprite sheets in Blender, free local image-to-3D and local asset models on Apple Silicon, batched art waves from an image model with crop and palette checks, bot-played deterministic playtests and screenshot proof, voice casting before paid generation, and the hard-won lessons from shipping a roguelite and a tower-defense game.

plugins.name: explainer-forge
plugins.description: Make narrated explainer and instructional videos, measured instead of eyeballed: a narrator voice designed once and cloned and recorded as ONE take for the whole script with a uniform tempo set to a measured pace and capped gaps (one clip per line with exact cue times stays as a fallback), two bundled voices, a house style and a mascot, sprite-world animation on a reusable engine (camera, belts, tokens, captions with safe areas), product footage captured with sample data, a frame-exact render to MP4 with word-timed captions, and a proof pass over every scene, text size, dead air and the A/V sync.
